visual.general_description: Two side-by-side circular endoscopic-style color views of an ear cavity filled with pale yellow-white lumpy material.
visual.detailed_description: Two circular color images on a black background. The left image shows a funnel-like canal with tan-pink walls leading to a central oval opening that is filled with pale yellow-white, lumpy material; white flaky patches lie along the rim and on the walls, and a bright reflection appears at the lower left. The right image is a closer, greenish-tinted view of a cavity packed with pale cream-white, irregular, crumbly or friable-looking material, with a small gray shiny area at the upper left of the mass and a dark recess at the lower right. A black upward-pointing arrow sits at the top edge of each circle. No panel letters, text labels, scale bar or identifying text are visible.

Each panel carries its bold black letter at the upper right. No scale bars or identifying text are visible.

panels.general_description: Close-up color photograph of skin with a row of dark blue stitches beside a small red open area.
panels.detailed_description: A close-up color photograph of pink skin. A line of dark blue interrupted stitches runs diagonally from the upper left toward the lower middle. Next to the upper part of the suture line is a small, moist, red, shallow open area with a pinker margin. A pale blue gloved hand or glove edge covers the top left, and a pale yellow-cream area lies at the upper right. Small dark crust-like specks sit along the lower suture line. The letter A is printed in bold black at the upper right of the panel. No scale or identifying text is visible.
